chapter.title: Chapter Thirteen: Museum of the Block
chapter.subtitle: Do not laminate somebody else's memory.
chapter.description: The block builds a living exhibit while arguing over whose version deserves the biggest frame.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Name, date, owner. If you don’t know whose picture it is, put it down.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: I have footage.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: You have requests to make.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Leave the memorial shirt out unless everybody harmed by that lie agrees.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: Agreed. We do not turn pain into a centerpiece because the frame is dramatic.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: That was almost emotionally literate. Hold still while I mark the date.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: I brought miniature folding chairs made from commissary wrappers.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: And I brought the exact time he stole my glue.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: Borrowed. The museum will contextualize it.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
preDialogue.text: Winner writes the label for my chair sculpture.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Informant
preDialogue.text: Label must include disputed adhesive provenance.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Source note, not an accusation in all caps.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I printed GLUE SITUATION before guidance arrived.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Every object get a date or it don’t get a shelf. That’s the law of the crate.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
preDialogue.text: My tiny chairs survived worse than this roof. They need secure display.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Informant
preDialogue.text: And a corrected glue credit. I been erased before. Not again.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: No child photos in the public case. Ever. Non-negotiable.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: History without the private parts. We can do both.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Both it is. Label maker locked and loaded.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
postDialogue.text: Use your label. The chairs still recline if you pinch the wrapper.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Informant
postDialogue.text: Add that the mechanism was my idea.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: Add both names and move on before the label becomes a miniseries.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Dates locked. Glue credit corrected. Tiny chairs secured.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Informant
postDialogue.text: Name back on the record. That’s all I needed.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Public case stay clean. Private stay private. Good.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

tips: Order the evidence by its authentic timestamps.

puzzle.title: The rail in five photographs
puzzle.instruction: Order the five repair records by what physically changed. These photographs have no reliable timestamps. Bolt holes and primer remain visible in later stages; nobody removes or repaints them.

pieces.label: Signed inspection
pieces.detail: Inspector’s sticker crosses dry yellow paint. All bolts fitted.

pieces.label: Drilled rail
pieces.detail: New bolt holes. Bare metal inside and outside them. No primer.

pieces.label: Delivered rail
pieces.detail: Unpierced bare metal. Supplier’s wrapping still attached.

pieces.label: Bolts and yellow paint
pieces.detail: Primer visible under yellow edges. All bolts fitted. No sticker.

pieces.label: Primed rail
pieces.detail: Primer lines the drilled holes. No bolts or yellow paint.

hints: Track irreversible changes: holes, primer, bolts and paint, sticker.
Bare holes precede primed holes. The sticker crosses finished paint.
puzzle.solvedText: Delivered, drilled, primed, assembled and painted, inspected. The material record backs the repair crew’s account even with the broken camera clock.
puzzle.skipText: The group orders the copies together. You receive the same story progress, with no puzzle bonus.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Five photos. Camera clock reset, but the rail still tells us what happened.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Informant
scenes.text: I can identify the drill bit by the way it disappointed me.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I contributed the thumb in photo two.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Then move it so we can see.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
preDialogue.text: My booth records dedications. Winner gets prime audio time.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Nobody records a child, a private call, or a story they cannot release.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
preDialogue.text: Understood. My dedication is to Keisha and the concept of patience.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: The concept declined comment.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Memory booth is open. People can leave a twenty-second story. No cuts, no sponsors.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: And no filming kids. Sign is big. Enforce it.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m the bouncer of memory. Twenty seconds or the label maker come out.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: I got a twenty-second apology ready if anybody need one.

preDialogue.speaker: Cracked Head
preDialogue.text: Save it for the person it belong to. Not the booth.

postDialogue.speaker: Inmate Boyfriend
postDialogue.text: Prime slot is yours. I will record mine after the permission forms.

postDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
postDialogue.text: Ask Keisha before you play it. I am not refereeing another voicemail breakup.

postDialogue.speaker: Snitch
postDialogue.text: I turned my camera off. Please note the personal growth while it cannot be verified.

postDialogue.speaker: Snitch
postDialogue.text: Booth full. No kid footage. Sources credited. I’m almost proud.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Pride logged. Archive growing. Milk crate still the MVP.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: MVP of storage. Don’t let it go to its head.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

phases.name: Public Pressure
phases.description: At round three, the opponent gains 1 Motion.

phases.name: Late Arrival
phases.description: At round 6, the opponent draws one card from its remaining ten-card deck. If the deck is empty, no card is added.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Winner chooses the exhibit order. Every item remains sourced.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Put labor before leaders. The lights did not keep themselves on.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Name the women who organized, cooked, cleaned, and fixed your math.

preDialogue.speaker: OG Uncle
preDialogue.text: And place my false story where nobody mistakes it for protection without a cost.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: This table is the archive. Everything got a date or it don’t get a shelf.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Crafty
preDialogue.text: Tiny chairs need secure display. They survived worse than this roof.

preDialogue.speaker: Inmate Informant
preDialogue.text: Corrected glue credit. I been erased before. Not again.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: No child photos in the public case. Ever. That’s the only non-negotiable.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Agreed. History without the private parts. We can do both.

preDialogue.speaker: Church Auntie
preDialogue.text: And somebody feed the people running the booth. Archive don’t run on air.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: Order accepted: people, work, conflict, repair, future.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: My Crown photo can go by the mop schedule.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Shelf locked. Credits correct. Chairs safe. I’m taking a victory nap on the crate.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: I’ll do the checklist. No livestream. Just the list.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: This museum does not make us innocent. It makes us legible.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: And the parenting schedule stays off the wall.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Correct. Our child's life is not community memorabilia.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: Techbro offered to sponsor the exhibit if his portrait opens it.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Tell him the mop already has a sponsor slot.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Two new buyers contacted him after the news story.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Then the exhibit must travel. One roof cannot be the only place holding its own evidence.

scenes.speaker: Inmate Crafty
scenes.text: My chairs fold flat. I designed for institutional instability.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Load the milk crate. The museum is going on tour.
